rules.sentence: In head and neck lesions, especially where basaloid features are present, a combination of p63 or p40, EMA, and Ber-EP4 can reliably separate SCC from adnexal tumors or BCC.
In spindle cell or undifferentiated tumors, the addition of S100 and SOX10 is crucial to exclude melanoma, while Ki-67 and pan-cytokeratin confirm epithelial lineage and assess proliferation.
